style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, pale mint #DDEDE5 and warm coral #F4C9BC gradients for info and scene screens, deep pine green #1E5B4A only as accent bands

style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting, front or upper-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft feminine care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, pale mint #DDEDE5, warm coral #F4C9BC with deep pine green #1E5B4A as the only accent; bright soft diffused studio lighting with gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line rounded icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable centered product placement and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable centered product placement, gentle S-curve stance for hero shots, consistent scale across the set
